item.title: Whiskers 0.8.25
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.25

### A Clearer, Guided Setup Flow

  • New onboarding walks you through microphone access, Accessibility access, and choosing a transcription model.
  • A “Try it” step helps confirm everything is working before you start using Whiskers day to day.
  • You can restart onboarding from Settings if you want to re-run setup later.

    • ### Better Setup Feedback in Settings

  • Settings now show clear “needs attention” badges so you can see what is still missing at a glance.
  • Permissions and Models pages include more direct recovery actions and clearer guidance when something is blocked.

    • ### Helpful Prompts When Something Is Missing

  • When you try to transcribe without required setup, Whiskers shows lightweight in-app prompts with one-click links to the right Settings page.
  • Bulk Transcription now guides you to select a model before adding files.

    • ### Fixes and Polish

  • Improved global hotkey handling for more consistent push-to-talk and shortcut behavior.
